   215	  function doAction(b) {
   216	    Sfx.unlock();
   217	    if (b.id === 'cell') {
   218	      doTap(b.cx, b.cy);
   219	      return;
   220	    }
   221	    Sfx.click();
   222	    switch (b.id) {
   223	      case 'retry': newLevel(S.level); break;
   224	      case 'next': newLevel(Math.min(G.MAXLV, S.level + 1)); break;
   225	      case 'levels': S.overlay = ''; S.screen = 'levels'; S.sel = S.level; break;
   226	      case 'back': S.screen = 'play'; break;
   227	      case 'hint': useHint(); break;
   228	      case 'sound':
   229	        save.mute = save.mute ? 0 : 1; Sfx.setMuted(!!save.mute); Store.save(save);
   230	        break;
   231	      case 'pick':
   232	        if (b.n <= save.unlocked) { newLevel(b.n); S.screen = 'play'; }
   233	        break;
   234	    }
   235	  }

   309	  function rr(x, y, w, h, r) {
   310	    ctx.beginPath();
   311	    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
   312	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
   313	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
   314	    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
   315	    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
   316	    ctx.closePath();
   317	  }
   318	  function txt(s, x, y, size, col, align, weight) {

   321	    ctx.textAlign = align || 'left';

   540	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

   685	  /* ---------------- update ---------------- */
   686	  function update(dt) {
   687	    S.t += dt;
   688	    var b = S.board, i;
   689	    // tile physics (units = rows)
   690	    for (i = 0; i < b.cells.length; i++) {
   691	      var c = b.cells[i];
   692	      if (!c) continue;
   693	      if (c.oy < 0) {
   694	        c.vy += 46 * dt;
   695	        c.oy += c.vy * dt;
   696	        if (c.oy >= 0) { c.oy = 0; c.vy = 0; }
   697	      } else if (c.oy > 0) {
   698	        c.oy -= 7 * dt;
   699	        if (c.oy <= 0) c.oy = 0;
   700	      }
   701	      if (c.flash > 0) c.flash = Math.max(0, c.flash - dt * 2.4);
   702	    }
   703	    for (i = S.parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   704	      var p = S.parts[i];
   705	      p.life -= dt;
   706	      if (p.life <= 0) { S.parts.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   707	      p.vy += 520 * dt; p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
   708	    }
   709	    for (i = S.fx.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { S.fx[i].life -= dt; if (S.fx[i].life <= 0) S.fx.splice(i, 1); }
   710	    for (i = S.floats.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   711	      S.floats[i].life -= dt; S.floats[i].y -= 34 * dt;
   712	      if (S.floats[i].life <= 0) S.floats.splice(i, 1);
   713	    }
   714	    if (S.shake > 0) S.shake = Math.max(0, S.shake - dt * 34);
   715	    if (S.hintT > 0) S.hintT = Math.max(0, S.hintT - dt);
   716	    if (S.overlay === 'win') {
   717	      S.winT += dt;
   718	      var want = Math.min(S.board.stars, Math.floor(S.winT / 0.32));
   719	      if (want > S.starShown) { S.starShown = want; Sfx.star(want - 1); }
   720	    }
   721	  }
   722	
   723	  /* ---------------- frame ---------------- */
   724	  function frame(now) {
   725	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   726	    var dt = (now - last) / 1000;
   727	    last = now;
   728	    if (!isFinite(dt) || dt < 0) dt = 0;
   729	    dt = Math.min(dt, 0.05);
   730	
   731	    // rotate overlay pauses the sim (hardening #1)
   732	    if (S.landscape && S.overlay !== 'rotate') {
   733	      S.prevOverlay = S.overlay; S.overlay = 'rotate'; resetInput();
   734	    } else if (!S.landscape && S.overlay === 'rotate') {
   735	      S.overlay = S.prevOverlay || ''; S.prevOverlay = '';
   736	    }
   737	    var paused = (S.overlay === 'rotate' || S.overlay === 'start');
   738	    if (!paused) update(dt);
   739	
   740	    hits.length = 0;
   741	    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
   742	    ctx.fillStyle = '#0b0e1a';
   743	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   744	
   745	    if (S.overlay === 'rotate') { drawRotate(); return; }
   746	
   747	    ctx.save();
   748	    if (S.shake > 0.2) {
   749	      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * S.shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * S.shake);
   750	    }
   751	    if (S.screen === 'levels') {
   752	      drawLevels();
   753	    } else {
   754	      drawHUD();
   755	      drawBoard();
   756	      drawFooter();
   757	      if (S.overlay === 'win') drawWin();
   758	      else if (S.overlay === 'lose') drawLose();
   759	    }
   760	    ctx.restore();
   761	    if (S.overlay === 'start') { hits.length = 0; drawStart(); }
   762	  }
   763	
   764	  /* ---------------- boot ---------------- */
   765	  var last = 0;
   766	  fit();
   767	  newLevel(S.level);
   768	  S.overlay = 'start';
   769	  last = performance.now();
   770	  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   771	})(window);
     1	/* Chroma Tap - board model, level generation, collapse / special resolution */
     2	(function (g) {
     3	  'use strict';
     4	
     5	  var COLS = 7, ROWS = 8, MAXLV = 25;
     6	  var SP_NONE = 0, SP_ROCKET = 1, SP_BOMB = 2, SP_ORB = 3;
     7	
     8	  /* ---------- level generation (seeded, deterministic) ---------- */
     9	  function levelDef(n) {
    10	    n = Math.max(1, Math.min(MAXLV, n | 0));
    11	    var r = g.CT.rng(9176 + n * 7919);
    12	    var colors = n <= 2 ? 4 : (n <= 8 ? 5 : (n % 4 === 0 ? 6 : 5));
    13	    var goals = { crate: 0, balloon: 0, gear: 0, pop: 0 };
    14	    var popColor = 0;
    15	
    16	    goals.crate = Math.min(8, 3 + Math.floor(n / 3));
    17	    if (n >= 4) goals.balloon = Math.min(5, 2 + Math.floor((n - 4) / 6));
    18	    if (n >= 7) goals.gear = Math.min(3, 1 + Math.floor((n - 7) / 7));
    19	    if (n >= 10 && n % 3 === 1) { goals.pop = 24 + ((n * 5) % 16); popColor = r.int(colors); }
    20	    if (n <= 2) goals.crate = 3 + n;
    21	
    22	    var mv = 11 + goals.crate * 2.4 + goals.balloon * 2.8 + goals.gear * 4 + goals.pop * 0.32;
    23	    mv = mv * (1.34 - n * 0.008) * (colors === 6 ? 1.18 : 1);
    24	    mv = Math.round(mv);
    25	    var moves = Math.max(15, Math.min(72, mv));
    26	
    27	    return {
    28	      n: n, colors: colors, moves: moves, goals: goals, popColor: popColor,
    29	      seed: 9176 + n * 7919
    30	    };
    31	  }
    32	
    33	  /* ---------- board ---------- */
    34	  var uid = 1;
    35	  function mkBlock(c) {
    36	    return { k: 'b', c: c, sp: SP_NONE, oy: 0, vy: 0, sc: 1, dead: 0, flash: 0, id: uid++ };
    37	  }
    38	  function mkObj(kind, c) {
    39	    return { k: kind, c: c || 0, sp: SP_NONE, oy: 0, vy: 0, sc: 1, dead: 0, flash: 0, hp: 1, id: uid++ };
    40	  }
    41	
    42	  function Board(def) {
    43	    this.def = def;
    44	    this.cols = COLS; this.rows = ROWS;
    45	    this.rng = g.CT.rng(def.seed);
    46	    this.cells = new Array(COLS * ROWS);
    47	    this.queue = [];          // per column: array of upcoming colors
    48	    this.movesLeft = def.moves;
    49	    this.movesUsed = 0;
    50	    this.score = 0;
    51	    this.prog = { crate: 0, balloon: 0, gear: 0, pop: 0 };
    52	    this.over = 0;            // 0 running, 1 win, -1 lose
    53	    this.stars = 0;
    54	    this.events = [];         // visual events for the renderer
    55	    this.shuffles = 0;
    56	    this.build();
    57	  }
    58	
    59	  Board.prototype.idx = function (x, y) { return y * this.cols + x; };
    60	  Board.prototype.at = function (x, y) {
    61	    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= this.cols || y >= this.rows) return null;
    62	    return this.cells[y * this.cols + x];
    63	  };
    64	  Board.prototype.set = function (x, y, v) { this.cells[y * this.cols + x] = v; };
    65	
    66	  Board.prototype.rc = function () { return this.rng.int(this.def.colors); };
    67	
    68	  Board.prototype.build = function () {
    69	    var x, y, i;
    70	    for (i = 0; i < COLS * ROWS; i++) this.cells[i] = mkBlock(this.rc());
    71	    this.queue = [];
    72	    for (x = 0; x < COLS; x++) {
    73	      var q = [];
    74	      for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) q.push(this.rc());
    75	      this.queue.push(q);
    76	    }
    77	    // obstacles. Gears go first and keep a clear chute of plain blocks beneath
    78	    // them, so digging a gear out is always a solvable line of play.
    79	    var gl = this.def.goals, k, tries, blocked = {}, usedCol = {};
    80	    for (k = 0; k < gl.gear; k++) {
    81	      for (tries = 0; tries < 80; tries++) {
    82	        x = this.rng.int(COLS);
    83	        y = 1 + this.rng.int(3);
    84	        if (usedCol[x]) continue;
    85	        var gc = this.at(x, y);
    86	        if (!gc || gc.k !== 'b') continue;
    87	        usedCol[x] = 1;
    88	        this.set(x, y, mkObj('gear'));
    89	        for (var yy = y + 1; yy < ROWS; yy++) blocked[x + ',' + yy] = 1;
    90	        break;
    91	      }
    92	    }
    93	    var spots = [];
    94	    for (k = 0; k < gl.crate; k++) spots.push(['crate', 2, ROWS - 2]);
    95	    for (k = 0; k < gl.balloon; k++) spots.push(['balloon', ROWS - 3, ROWS - 1]);
    96	    for (k = 0; k < spots.length; k++) {
    97	      for (tries = 0; tries < 90; tries++) {
    98	        x = this.rng.int(COLS);
    99	        y = spots[k][1] + this.rng.int(spots[k][2] - spots[k][1] + 1);
   100	        if (blocked[x + ',' + y]) continue;
   101	        var c = this.at(x, y);
   102	        if (!c || c.k !== 'b') continue;
   103	        // keep obstacles apart: a crate ringed by crates can become unreachable
   104	        if (tries < 70 && this.neighborObstacles(x, y) > 0) continue;
   105	        this.set(x, y, mkObj(spots[k][0]));
   106	        break;
   107	      }
   108	    }
   109	    // guarantee a legal opening move
   110	    for (tries = 0; tries < 30 && !this.hasMove(); tries++) this.shuffleColors();
   111	  };
   112	
   113	  Board.prototype.neighborObstacles = function (x, y) {
   114	    var d = [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]], n = 0;
   115	    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   116	      var c = this.at(x + d[i][0], y + d[i][1]);
   117	      if (c && c.k !== 'b') n++;
   118	    }
   119	    return n;
   120	  };
   121	
   122	  /* ---------- groups ---------- */
   123	  Board.prototype.groupAt = function (x, y) {
   124	    var c = this.at(x, y);
   125	    if (!c || c.k !== 'b' || c.sp !== SP_NONE) return [];
   126	    var seen = {}, out = [], st = [[x, y]];
   127	    seen[x + ',' + y] = 1;
   128	    while (st.length) {
   129	      var p = st.pop(), px = p[0], py = p[1];
   130	      out.push(p);
   131	      var d = [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]];
   132	      for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   133	        var nx = px + d[i][0], ny = py + d[i][1], key = nx + ',' + ny;
   134	        if (seen[key]) continue;
   135	        var q = this.at(nx, ny);
   136	        if (q && q.k === 'b' && q.sp === SP_NONE && q.c === c.c) { seen[key] = 1; st.push([nx, ny]); }
   137	      }
   138	    }
   139	    return out;
   140	  };
   141	
   142	  Board.prototype.hasMove = function () {
   143	    for (var y = 0; y < this.rows; y++) for (var x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   144	      var c = this.at(x, y);
   145	      if (!c || c.k !== 'b') continue;
   146	      if (c.sp !== SP_NONE) return true;
   147	      var r = this.at(x + 1, y), d = this.at(x, y + 1);
   148	      if (r && r.k === 'b' && r.sp === SP_NONE && r.c === c.c) return true;
   149	      if (d && d.k === 'b' && d.sp === SP_NONE && d.c === c.c) return true;
   150	    }
   151	    return false;
   152	  };
   153	
   154	  Board.prototype.shuffleColors = function () {
   155	    var list = [], i, x, y;
   156	    for (y = 0; y < this.rows; y++) for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   157	      var c = this.at(x, y);
   158	      if (c && c.k === 'b' && c.sp === SP_NONE) list.push(c);
   159	    }
   160	    for (i = list.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
   161	      var j = this.rng.int(i + 1), t = list[i].c; list[i].c = list[j].c; list[j].c = t;
   162	    }
   163	    this.shuffles++;
   164	  };
   165	
   166	  /* ---------- clearing ---------- */
   167	  Board.prototype._mark = function (x, y, set) {
   168	    var c = this.at(x, y);
   169	    if (!c || set[c.id]) return null;
   170	    set[c.id] = [x, y, c];
   171	    return c;
   172	  };
   173	
   174	  // Damage obstacles neighbouring a set of coords
   175	  Board.prototype._splash = function (coords, set) {
   176	    var d = [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]];
   177	    for (var i = 0; i < coords.length; i++) {
   178	      for (var j = 0; j < d.length; j++) {
   179	        var nx = coords[i][0] + d[j][0], ny = coords[i][1] + d[j][1];
   180	        var c = this.at(nx, ny);
   181	        if (!c) continue;
   182	        if (c.k === 'crate' || c.k === 'balloon') this._mark(nx, ny, set);
   183	      }
   184	    }
   185	  };
   186	
   187	  Board.prototype.blastOf = function (x, y, c, set, queue) {
   188	    var i, j;
   189	    if (c.sp === SP_ROCKET) {
   190	      if (c.rot) { for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) this._hit(x, j, set, queue); }
   191	      else { for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) this._hit(i, y, set, queue); }
   192	    } else if (c.sp === SP_BOMB) {
   193	      for (i = -2; i <= 2; i++) for (j = -2; j <= 2; j++) {
   194	        if (Math.abs(i) + Math.abs(j) <= 3) this._hit(x + i, y + j, set, queue);
   195	      }
   196	    } else if (c.sp === SP_ORB) {
   197	      var col = (typeof c.orbColor === 'number') ? c.orbColor : this.commonColor();
   198	      for (j = 0; j < this.rows; j++) for (i = 0; i < this.cols; i++) {
   199	        var t = this.at(i, j);
   200	        if (t && t.k === 'b' && (t.c === col || t.sp !== SP_NONE)) this._hit(i, j, set, queue);
   201	      }
   202	    }
   203	  };
   204	
   205	  Board.prototype._hit = function (x, y, set, queue) {
   206	    var c = this.at(x, y);
   207	    if (!c || set[c.id]) return;
   208	    if (c.k === 'b' && c.sp !== SP_NONE) {
   209	      if (queue.length < 96) queue.push([x, y, c]);
   210	      return;
   211	    }
   212	    set[c.id] = [x, y, c];
   213	  };
   214	
   215	  Board.prototype.commonColor = function () {
   216	    var cnt = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0], x, y, best = 0;
   217	    for (y = 0; y < this.rows; y++) for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   218	      var c = this.at(x, y);
   219	      if (c && c.k === 'b' && c.sp === SP_NONE) cnt[c.c]++;
   220	    }
   221	    for (x = 1; x < 6; x++) if (cnt[x] > cnt[best]) best = x;
   222	    return best;
   223	  };
   224	
   225	  // Fire one or more specials, chaining. Returns cleared set map.
   226	  Board.prototype.fireSpecials = function (starts) {
   227	    var set = {}, queue = starts.slice(), guard = 0;
   228	    while (queue.length && guard++ < 200) {
   229	      var e = queue.shift(), x = e[0], y = e[1], c = e[2];
   230	      if (set[c.id]) continue;
   330	        this.events.push({ t: 'make', x: x, y: y, sp: sp });
   331	      }
   332	      this.events.push({ t: 'pop', x: x, y: y, n: n });
   333	    }
   334	
   335	    var cleared = this.applyClear(set);
   336	    if (!cleared.length && !made) return null;
   337	
   338	    var base = Math.max(cleared.length, n);
   339	    this.score += base * base * 6 + cleared.length * 12;
   340	    this.movesLeft--; this.movesUsed++;
   341	
   342	    this.settle();
   343	    this.endOfMove();
   344	    return { cleared: cleared, made: made, n: cleared.length };
   345	  };
   346	
   347	  Board.prototype.bestNeighborColor = function (x, y) {
   348	    var d = [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]], best = -1, bn = 0;
   349	    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   350	      var q = this.at(x + d[i][0], y + d[i][1]);
   351	      if (q && q.k === 'b' && q.sp === SP_NONE) {
   352	        var n = this.groupAt(x + d[i][0], y + d[i][1]).length;
   353	        if (n > bn) { bn = n; best = q.c; }
   354	      }
   355	    }
   356	    return best < 0 ? this.commonColor() : best;
   357	  };
   358	
   359	  // Remove all cells in set, tally goals. Returns list of [x,y,cell]
   360	  Board.prototype.applyClear = function (set) {
   361	    var out = [], k;
   362	    for (k in set) {
   363	      var e = set[k], x = e[0], y = e[1], c = e[2];
   364	      if (this.at(x, y) !== c) continue;
   365	      if (c.k === 'crate') this.prog.crate++;
   366	      else if (c.k === 'balloon') this.prog.balloon++;
   367	      else if (c.k === 'gear') {
   368	        // plain collapses never touch a gear (see _splash); only a blast knocks it loose
   369	        this.prog.gear++;
   370	        this.events.push({ t: 'gear', x: x, y: y });
   371	      }
   372	      else if (c.k === 'b' && c.c === this.def.popColor) this.prog.pop++;
   373	      this.set(x, y, null);
   374	      out.push(e);
   375	    }
   376	    return out;
   377	  };
   378	
   379	  /* ---------- gravity + refill ---------- */
   380	  Board.prototype.settle = function () {
   381	    var x, y, CELL = 1;
   382	    for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   383	      var write = this.rows - 1;
   384	      for (y = this.rows - 1; y >= 0; y--) {
   385	        var c = this.cells[y * this.cols + x];
   386	        if (!c) continue;
   387	        if (write !== y) {
   388	          this.cells[write * this.cols + x] = c;
   389	          this.cells[y * this.cols + x] = null;
   390	          c.oy = (y - write) * CELL;   // rows above (negative), scaled by renderer
   391	          c.vy = 0;
   392	        }
   393	        write--;
   394	      }
   395	      for (y = write; y >= 0; y--) {
   396	        var q = this.queue[x];
   397	        while (q.length < 4) q.push(this.rc());
   398	        if (q.length > 8) q.length = 8;
   399	        var nb = mkBlock(q.shift());
   400	        q.push(this.rc());
   401	        nb.oy = -(write - y + 1);
   402	        nb.vy = 0;
   403	        this.cells[y * this.cols + x] = nb;
   404	      }
   405	    }
   406	  };
   407	
   408	  /* ---------- end of move ---------- */
   409	  Board.prototype.endOfMove = function () {
   410	    var x, y, c;
   411	    // gears are heavy: each move they sink one row through a plain block
   412	    for (y = this.rows - 2; y >= 0; y--) for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   413	      c = this.at(x, y);
   414	      if (c && c.k === 'gear') {
   415	        var dn = this.at(x, y + 1);
   416	        if (dn && dn.k === 'b' && dn.sp === SP_NONE) {
   417	          this.set(x, y + 1, c); this.set(x, y, dn);
   418	          c.oy = -1; dn.oy = 1;
   419	        }
   420	      }
   421	    }
   422	    // gears reaching the floor are collected
   423	    for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   424	      c = this.at(x, this.rows - 1);
   425	      if (c && c.k === 'gear') {
   426	        this.prog.gear++;
   427	        this.events.push({ t: 'gear', x: x, y: this.rows - 1 });
   428	        this.set(x, this.rows - 1, null);
   429	      }
   430	    }
   431	    // balloons rise one cell (swap with a plain block above)
   432	    var risers = [];
   433	    for (y = 1; y < this.rows; y++) for (x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   434	      c = this.at(x, y);
   435	      if (c && c.k === 'balloon' && !c._rose) {
   436	        var up = this.at(x, y - 1);
   437	        if (up && up.k === 'b') {
   438	          this.set(x, y - 1, c); this.set(x, y, up);
   439	          c.oy = 1; up.oy = -1; c._rose = 1; risers.push(c);
   440	        }
   441	      }
   442	    }
   443	    for (x = 0; x < risers.length; x++) risers[x]._rose = 0;
   444	    this.settle();
   445	
   446	    // goal / fail evaluation
   447	    var gl = this.def.goals, done =
   448	      this.prog.crate >= gl.crate && this.prog.balloon >= gl.balloon &&
   449	      this.prog.gear >= gl.gear && this.prog.pop >= gl.pop;
   450	    if (done) {
   451	      this.over = 1;
   452	      var ratio = this.movesLeft / Math.max(1, this.def.moves);
   453	      this.stars = ratio >= 0.38 ? 3 : (ratio >= 0.15 ? 2 : 1);
   454	      this.score += this.movesLeft * 120;
   455	    } else if (this.movesLeft <= 0) {
   456	      this.over = -1;
   457	    } else {
   458	      var guard = 0;
   459	      while (!this.hasMove() && guard++ < 30) this.shuffleColors();
   460	    }
   461	    if (this.score > 99999999) this.score = 99999999;
   462	  };
   463	
   464	  Board.prototype.goalsLeft = function () {
   465	    var gl = this.def.goals, out = [];
   466	    if (gl.crate) out.push({ k: 'crate', need: gl.crate, have: Math.min(gl.crate, this.prog.crate) });
   467	    if (gl.balloon) out.push({ k: 'balloon', need: gl.balloon, have: Math.min(gl.balloon, this.prog.balloon) });
   468	    if (gl.gear) out.push({ k: 'gear', need: gl.gear, have: Math.min(gl.gear, this.prog.gear) });
   469	    if (gl.pop) out.push({ k: 'pop', need: gl.pop, have: Math.min(gl.pop, this.prog.pop), c: this.def.popColor });
   470	    return out;
   471	  };
   472	
   473	  // Best available group, for the hint button
   474	  Board.prototype.hint = function () {
   475	    var best = null, bn = 1, seen = {};
   476	    for (var y = 0; y < this.rows; y++) for (var x = 0; x < this.cols; x++) {
   477	      var c = this.at(x, y);
   478	      if (!c || c.k !== 'b') continue;
   479	      if (c.sp !== SP_NONE) return [[x, y]];
   480	      if (seen[c.id]) continue;
   481	      var grp = this.groupAt(x, y);
   482	      for (var i = 0; i < grp.length; i++) { var q = this.at(grp[i][0], grp[i][1]); if (q) seen[q.id] = 1; }
   483	      if (grp.length > bn) { bn = grp.length; best = grp; }
   484	    }
   485	    return best;
   486	  };

     6	  /* ---------- seeded rng (mulberry32) ---------- */
     7	  T.rng = function (seed) {
     8	    var a = (seed >>> 0) || 1;
     9	    return function () {
    10	      a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
    11	      var t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    12	      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    13	      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    14	    };
    15	  };

    17	  /* ---------- storage (hardening #4) ---------- */
    18	  var KEY = 'terrace-tales-v1';
    19	  T.store = {
    20	    load: function () {
    21	      var d = { lvl: 0, choices: [], best: {}, seen: false, done: false };
    22	      try {
    23	        var raw = window.localStorage.getItem(KEY);
    24	        if (typeof raw !== 'string' || !raw) return d;
    25	        var o = JSON.parse(raw);
    26	        if (!o || typeof o !== 'object' || Array.isArray(o)) return d;
    27	        if (typeof o.lvl === 'number' && isFinite(o.lvl)) d.lvl = Math.max(0, Math.min(15, o.lvl | 0));
    28	        if (Array.isArray(o.choices)) {
    29	          for (var i = 0; i < 15 && i < o.choices.length; i++) {
    30	            var v = o.choices[i];
    31	            d.choices[i] = (typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v) && (v | 0) === 1) ? 1 : 0;
    32	          }

    34	        if (o.best && typeof o.best === 'object' && !Array.isArray(o.best)) {
    35	          var kept = 0;

    43	          }
    44	        }

    46	        d.done = o.done === true;
    47	        // prune: choices length capped

    49	      } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }

    51	    },

   104	        g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);

   106	        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);
   107	        o.connect(g); g.connect(master);
   108	        o.start(t0); o.stop(t0 + dur + 0.03);
   109	      } catch (e) { }
   110	    },
   111	    noise: function (dur, vol, delay) {

   121	        var g = actx.createGain(); g.gain.value = vol == null ? 0.25 : vol;
   122	        s.connect(f); f.connect(g); g.connect(master); s.start(t0);
   123	      } catch (e) { }
   124	    }

   137	function toDesign(cx, cy) {
   138	  var r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
   139	  return { x: (cx - r.left - offX) / scale, y: (cy - r.top - offY) / scale };
   140	}

   142	function ptrDown(id, cx, cy) {
   143	  var p = toDesign(cx, cy);
   144	  Input.ptr[id] = { id: id, x: p.x, y: p.y, px: p.x, py: p.y, dx: 0, dy: 0, down: true, startX: p.x, startY: p.y, moved: false, t: performance.now() };
   145	  if (Input.primaryId === null) Input.primaryId = id;
   146	}
   147	function ptrMove(id, cx, cy) {
   148	  var e = Input.ptr[id]; if (!e) return;
   149	  var p = toDesign(cx, cy);
   150	  e.dx += p.x - e.x; e.dy += p.y - e.y;
   151	  e.px = e.x; e.py = e.y; e.x = p.x; e.y = p.y;
   152	  if (Math.abs(e.x - e.startX) > 8 || Math.abs(e.y - e.startY) > 8) e.moved = true;
   153	}
   154	function ptrUp(id, cancelled) {
   155	  var e = Input.ptr[id]; if (!e) return;
   156	  if (!cancelled && !e.moved && performance.now() - e.t < 700) {
   157	    Input.taps.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y });
   158	    if (Input.taps.length > 8) Input.taps.shift();
   159	  }
   160	  Input.releases.push({ id: id, x: e.x, y: e.y, startX: e.startX, startY: e.startY, cancelled: !!cancelled });
   161	  if (Input.releases.length > 8) Input.releases.shift();
   162	  delete Input.ptr[id];
   163	  if (Input.primaryId === id) {
   164	    var l = Input.list();
   165	    Input.primaryId = l.length ? l[0].id : null;
   166	  }
   167	}

   475	    if (!step) { BC.doSwap(b, i, j); return false; }

   488	  function playout(lv, seed) {
   489	    var init = BC.initBoardFor(lv);
   490	    var b = init.board;
   491	    var rand = BC.rng(seed);
   492	    var st = BC.newState(lv);
   493	    var guard = 0;

    19	  /* ---- run detection ---- */
    20	  function findRuns(b) {
    21	    var runs = [], x, y, i, c, run;
    22	    for (y = 0; y < b.h; y++) {
    23	      x = 0;
    24	      while (x < b.w) {
    25	        i = y * b.w + x; c = b.c[i];
    26	        if (c < 0) { x++; continue; }
    27	        var x2 = x;
    28	        while (x2 + 1 < b.w && b.c[y * b.w + x2 + 1] === c) x2++;
    29	        if (x2 - x + 1 >= 3) {
    30	          run = [];
    31	          for (var k = x; k <= x2; k++) run.push(y * b.w + k);
    32	          runs.push({ dir: 0, cells: run, color: c });
    33	        }
    34	        x = x2 + 1;
    35	      }
    36	    }
    37	    for (x = 0; x < b.w; x++) {
    38	      y = 0;
    39	      while (y < b.h) {
    40	        i = y * b.w + x; c = b.c[i];
    41	        if (c < 0) { y++; continue; }
    42	        var y2 = y;
    43	        while (y2 + 1 < b.h && b.c[(y2 + 1) * b.w + x] === c) y2++;
    44	        if (y2 - y + 1 >= 3) {
    45	          run = [];
    46	          for (var k2 = y; k2 <= y2; k2++) run.push(k2 * b.w + x);
    47	          runs.push({ dir: 1, cells: run, color: c });
    48	        }
    49	        y = y2 + 1;
    50	      }
    51	    }
    52	    return runs;
    53	  }
    54	
    55	  function groupRuns(runs) {
    56	    var groups = [], i, j;
    57	    for (i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
    58	      var r = runs[i], hit = -1;
    59	      for (j = 0; j < groups.length; j++) {
    60	        var g = groups[j];
    61	        if (g.color !== r.color) continue;
    62	        var share = false;
    63	        for (var k = 0; k < r.cells.length && !share; k++) if (g.set[r.cells[k]]) share = true;
    64	        if (share) { hit = j; break; }
    65	      }
    66	      if (hit < 0) {
    67	        var set = {}; for (var m = 0; m < r.cells.length; m++) set[r.cells[m]] = 1;
    68	        groups.push({ color: r.color, runs: [r], set: set });
    69	      } else {
    70	        groups[hit].runs.push(r);
    71	        for (var m2 = 0; m2 < r.cells.length; m2++) groups[hit].set[r.cells[m2]] = 1;
    72	      }
    73	    }
    74	    for (i = 0; i < groups.length; i++) {
    75	      var cells = [];
    76	      for (var key in groups[i].set) cells.push(key | 0);
    77	      groups[i].cells = cells;
    78	    }
    79	    return groups;
    80	  }

    86	    var counts = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0], i, best = 0, bc = -1;

    99	  // expands special chains inside a clear-set (object used as set)
   100	  function expand(b, set, rand, fx) {
   101	    var q = [], i;
   102	    for (var key in set) { i = key | 0; if (b.sp[i] > 0) q.push(i); }
   103	    var done = {};
   104	    for (i = 0; i < q.length; i++) done[q[i]] = 1;
   105	    var guard = 0;
   106	    while (q.length && guard++ < 4096) {
   107	      var idx = q.shift();
   108	      var sp = b.sp[idx];
   109	      if (!sp) continue;
   110	      var cells = specialCells(b, idx, sp, rand);
   111	      if (fx) fx.push({ i: idx, sp: sp });
   112	      for (var m = 0; m < cells.length; m++) {
   113	        var j = cells[m];

   115	        if (b.c[j] === ACORN || b.c[j] === EMPTY) continue;
   116	        if (!set[j]) set[j] = 1;
   117	        if (b.sp[j] > 0 && !done[j]) { done[j] = 1; q.push(j); }
   118	      }
   119	    }
   120	  }
